name: Ban Lists
description: Every TCG (May 2002 - September 2026) and OCG (August 1999 - October 2026) Forbidden & Limited List as a single-player mod.
details: PD Limits\TCG and PD Limits\OCG hold every list as a single-player mod that replaces the game's own list (pd_limits.bin): copy the one you want into the game's Mods folder. For online lobbies the same 82 TCG (formatlibrary.com) and 88 OCG (yugipedia.com) lists ship with Yu-Gi-Oh-MP itself (Create Match > More Options > Ban list); this mod isn't needed for that.
